cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(nsx_startup_ownership C CXX ASM)
include("${NSX_TEST_HARNESS_ROOT}/tests/hardware/common/firmware.cmake")
if(NOT NSX_TEST_BOARD MATCHES "^(apollo3p_evb|apollo4p_blue_kxr_evb|apollo510_evb|apollo510b_evb|apollo330mP_evb)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Startup ownership smoke requires a supported AP3/AP4/AP510/AP330 board")
endif()
nsx_add_test_firmware(startup_ownership main.c MODULES interrupt timer power)
